title: Per-feature deterministic workspaces
body: Symphony spawns a deterministic workspace per ticket; compose uses cwd. Worktree-per-feature would isolate concurrent builds, eliminate the active-build last-writer-wins race, and match the worktree pattern compose already uses for tier-2 hard-bug escalation. Cost: every feature triggers `git worktree add`, more disk, slower iteration when switching features. Worth gating behind a `--worktree` flag first; promote to default only if telemetry shows it pays. **Foundation for IDEA-11.**
